dedupe_keys.name: ptc attrezzature e servizi di gestione del rischio e protezione civile

description: The Province of Arezzo publishes preliminary public-facility and service-site inventories for its territorial coordination plan (PTC). This group retains the existing risk-management and civil-protection layer and adds five complementary inventories: waste-management facilities, university and higher-education sites, infrastructure-management premises, institutional premises and healthcare/hospital sites. Their native lineage describes locating plants from the area waste plan, digitising facility buildings on CTR 1:10000, using provincial property records and mapping healthcare sites. These are physical facilities, not organisation totals. Coverage is the province, with the emergency layer based on the 2017 integrated civil-protection plan. Facility locations can support capacity planning and emergency response simulations, but current service capacity, operating condition and completeness remain unverified. Source metadata lists Shapefile and geospatial service routes. It includes a public-access restriction under INSPIRE Article 13(1)(a) and no standard reuse licence; underlying access and costs were not tested. No features or files were downloaded. Original emergency-layer links are preserved, and the five added members are joined through the same source-defined PTC facility programme. Related inventories concern other provincial assets.
